pyqgis_plugin.name: MaRu ALS 3D
pyqgis_plugin.description: Maa- ja Ruumiamet 3D aerolaserskaneerimise (ALS) LAZ kõrguspunktide allalaadimine ja vaatamine noole või ristkülikuga valiku abil./Download and visualize Estonian Land and Spatial Board (Maa- ja Ruumiamet) 3D airborne LiDAR (ALS) LAZ point clouds by dragging an arrow or rectangle.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Võimaldab kaardil noolt või ristkülikut vedades tuvastada 1:2000 kaardilehed, laadida automaatselt alla vastavad LAZ punktipilved, avada need 2D ja 3D vaates ning valida erinevate lennuaastate (tava vs mets) vahel./Allows dragging an arrow or rectangle on the canvas to detect 1:2000 map tiles, automatically download corresponding LAZ point clouds, display them in 2D and 3D views, and select between different flight years (regular leaf-off vs forest).

pyqgis_plugin.name: Overlap Toolkit
pyqgis_plugin.description: Kiire polügoonide ülekatete ja koondstatistika tööriist / Fast polygon overlap and aggregate statistics tool
pyqgis_plugin.about: Kiire ja mugav tööriist polügoonide tavaliste ja grupeeritud ülekatete arvutamiseks, koondstatistika tegemiseks ja tulemuste automaatseks kujundamiseks. Sisaldab otsefailide laadimist ja Eesti WFS-kataloogi tuge (EELIS, Kataster, PRIA, ETAK). Fast tool for polygon overlap calculations, grouped overlap analysis, aggregate statistics, and automatic layer styling. Features direct PC file loading and Estonian WFS service catalog integration (EELIS, Cadastre, PRIA, ETAK).

pyqgis_plugin.name: GeoKataloog
pyqgis_plugin.description: Eesti ruumiandmeteenuste otsing, kihtide ja geomeetriate eelvaade ning QGIS-i ühenduste profiilihaldur.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Eesti ja rahvusvaheliste ruumiandmeteenuste (WFS, WMS, WCS, WMTS jne) kataloog, kihtide ja segageomeetriate testija ning profiilihaldur. Võimaldab otsida ja avada kaardikihte, lahutada segageomeetriaid punktideks, joonteks ja polügoonideks ning hallata ja sünkroonida QGIS-i ühenduste profiile.

pyqgis_plugin.name: AutoZoom on selection
pyqgis_plugin.description: Automatically zoom the map canvas to features when you select them in any layer's attribute table. Toggleable.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Automatically zoom the map canvas to features when you select them in any layer's attribute table (or canvas). Works for any vector layer and can be toggled on/off.

pyqgis_plugin.name: estonian-address-search
pyqgis_plugin.description: Tööriist võimaldab otsida Eesti ametlikke aadresse ning katastritunnuseid. Põhineb In-ADS API-l

pyqgis_plugin.name: MAFotoladu
pyqgis_plugin.description: Click any location on the map canvas to open the corresponding coordinates in Maa- ja Ruumiamet Fotoladu (fotoladu.maaamet.ee). Compatible with QGIS 3 and QGIS 4.

pyqgis_plugin.name: EstHub Satiladu viewer
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS pistikprogramm Sentinel-2 ja Landsat-8 satelliidipiltide sirvimiseks ja võrdlemiseks. Programm toimib läbi ESTHub Satiladu teenuse. Andmete algallikaks on Copernicus programm.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Mavic 3E Projector
pyqgis_plugin.description: Projects vector layers onto raw DJI 3E/4T photos and draws the camera FOV on the 2D map. Add pins directly onto photos and display them on 2d map.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Reads DJI XMP EXIF data and uses OpenCV to map 3D vector features onto the 2D image plane, and reverse ray-casts the camera footprint.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Target
pyqgis_plugin.description: In-place Erase and Erase Outside clipping tool (with Set Target feature)
pyqgis_plugin.about: Lets user set features as targets and clip them with selected objects (erase/erase outside). Compatible with QGIS 3.x and 4.x. Added disaggregate function as of v1.04 and Fit Target v1.05 (preview).

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS TAB Exporter
pyqgis_plugin.description: QGIS shift-free TAB exporter/Ekspordi QGISst TAB formaati ilma geomeetria nihketa
pyqgis_plugin.about: Prevents coordinate shifting by enforcing strict bounds and Decimal snapping.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Natura topology check
pyqgis_plugin.description: Compares user registry inputs against EELIS:natura_elupaik WFS layer and runs MapInfo/EELIS style topology checks.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Compares user registry inputs against EELIS:natura_elupaik WFS layer and runs MapInfo/EELIS style topology checks.

pyqgis_plugin.name: QGIS Pivot Dashboard
pyqgis_plugin.description: Drag and drop pivot table dashboard for spatial and attribute statistics. Spatial join, geosearch, WFS catalog.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A flexible BI-style pivot dashboard for QGIS layers.
